name: Chongqing Zongshen Power Machinery Co.,Ltd
summary: Chongqing Zongshen Power Machinery Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of small and medium-sized power machinery products, and end-products in China and internationally. The company operates through Engines; General Machinery; Parent Company and Products Parts; and Supply Chain Finance segments. It offers motor engines; and general machinery products, such as welding stations, high pressure cleaners, clean water pumps, motorhome generators, general purpose gasoline engine, countryside steward shepherd, mini tiller, parking generator, and heavy truck starting lithium battery.
